name: Diana Memorial Playground
description: Free playground in Kensington Gardens, reopened on 5 August 2026 after a £3 million renewal. The centrepiece is a new 17-metre pirate galleon on a sandy beach with crow's nests, a big tunnel slide and a play kitchen below deck. There's also a treehouse with three towers, a 4-metre tunnel slide and an accessible walkway with talk tubes and musical instruments, a crocodile water play area, and a younger children's area with timber houses, play ships and a large sandpit. Wheelchair users can get onto the galleon and treehouse, and there are raised tables at the sand and water play. Expect queues at weekends for the first few months.

rules: Adults can only go in with a child aged 12 or under, except between 9.30 and 10am. Closes 7.45pm May–Aug, 6.45pm Apr and Sep, 5.45pm Mar and early Oct, 4.45pm Feb and late Oct, 3.45pm Nov–Jan; last entry 15 minutes before. Water play is switched off during the Thames Water hosepipe ban.
